hindi: सौ पण पर मासिक धर्म्य ब्याज सवा पण है; व्यावहारिकी पाँच पण; बीहड़ वन से जाने वालों का दस पण; समुद्र के लोगों का बीस पण।
english: The lawful monthly interest on a hundred paṇas [is] a paṇa and a quarter; the vyāvahārikī, five paṇas; for those who go through the wilderness, ten paṇas; for seafarers, twenty paṇas.
notes: vṛddhi (literally 'increase') is rendered 'interest'. sapāda-paṇā = a paṇa with a quarter, i.e. one and a quarter. vyāvahārikī kept untranslated (literally 'of dealings'; glossary 5.3). sāmudra literally 'of the sea', rendered 'seafarers' (medium). The feminine endings agree with the unstated feminine vṛddhi.
lines_deva: सपाद.पणा धर्म्या मास.वृद्धिः पण.शतस्य, पञ्च.पणा व्यावहारिकी, दश.पणा कान्तारगाणाम्, विंशति.पणा सामुद्राणाम्
lines_iast: sapāda.paṇā dharmyā māsa.vṛddhiḥ paṇa.śatasya, pañca.paṇā vyāvahārikī, daśa.paṇā kāntāragāṇām, viṃśati.paṇā sāmudrāṇām

words.gloss: of the one who causes to do

hindi: इसके आगे कर्ता और करवाने वाले का प्रथम साहस-दण्ड; श्रोताओं में एक-एक का हर बार आधा दण्ड।
english: Beyond that, the first fine for rashness [is] for the doer and the one who causes it to be done; for the hearers, one by one, a half-penalty in each case.
notes: Predicate not stated; '[falls]' supplied in brackets. kartṛ/kārayitṛ (doer/causer) and śrotṛ (hearers) are left unspecified, as in the text (the preceding lines are not in this unit). pratyardha-daṇḍa: prati-ardha, literally 'half for each', rendered 'half-penalty in each case' (medium). Review: '[falls]' replaced by the bare copula '[is]' (glossary 13.2).
lines_deva: ततः परं कर्तुः कारयितुश् च पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, श्रोतॄणाम् एक.एकं प्रत्यर्ध.दण्डः
lines_iast: tataḥ paraṃ kartuḥ kārayituś ca pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, śrotṝṇām eka.ekaṃ pratyardha.daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: of the creditor and the debtor

hindi: किन्तु राजा में योग और क्षेम का अभाव लाने पर धनिक और ऋणी के आचरण की जाँच करे।
english: But when [it] brings to the king a lack of acquisition and security, [he] should examine the conduct of the creditor and the debtor.
notes: Locative absolute 'rājani ayoga-kṣema-āvahe' is uncertain: the compound could be 'bringing the absence of yoga-kṣema' (as rendered) and the exact construction ('in the king') is doubtful. yoga-kṣema = acquisition and security (glossary). Subject of avekṣeta unstated. dhanika (literally 'wealth-possessing') = creditor, dhāraṇika (literally 'holding / owing') = debtor.
lines_deva: राजन्य् अयोग.क्षेम.आवहे तु धनिक.धारणिकयोश् चरित्रम् अवेक्षेत
lines_iast: rājany ayoga.kṣema.āvahe tu dhanika.dhāraṇikayoś caritram avekṣeta

words.gloss: at the ripening of the crop

words.gram: f. nom. sg. p.p. tat-puruṣa (agrees with the unstated vṛddhiḥ)

hindi: फसल के पकने पर अनाज का ब्याज उपार्धा; इसके आगे मूल्य से किया हुआ बढ़े।
english: Interest on grain at the ripening of the crop [is] upārdhā; beyond that, [it,] made at the value, should increase.
notes: upārdhā is obscure (upa + ardha, literally 'near-half'; 'half in addition' also possible); kept untranslated. mūlya-kṛtā is also uncertain: literally 'made by/with value' (interest reckoned at the value); no sense is forced. Subject of vardheta is the interest, unstated. Low confidence.
lines_deva: धान्य.वृद्धिः सस्य.निष्पत्ताव् उपार्धा, परं मूल्य.कृता वर्धेत
lines_iast: dhānya.vṛddhiḥ sasya.niṣpattāv upārdhā, paraṃ mūlya.kṛtā vardheta

hindi: प्रक्षेप का ब्याज उपज का आधा; संनिधान-सन्ना वार्षिक देना चाहिए।
english: Interest on a putting-in [is] half of the yield; the annual [interest], saṃnidhāna-sannā, is to be given.
notes: Obscure terms kept literal: prakṣepa (literally 'throwing in', rendered 'addition'), udaya (literally 'rise', rendered 'yield'), saṃnidhāna-sannā (saṃnidhāna 'nearness, presence'; sannā 'sunk, settled'). The printed 'samnidhāna' has m for ṃ before n; not treated as an error. Sense of the whole line is doubtful. Review: translation of saṃnidhāna-sannā removed from English/Hindi (kept untranslated, literal 'sunk in saṃnidhāna' stays in the gloss only). vārṣikī = 'annual' is undecided against the 9.1 rule 'of the rainy season' (a person must decide). udayāt is read 'from the yield' (ablative of source), not a comparative.
lines_deva: प्रक्षेप.वृद्धिर् उदयाद् अर्धं सम्निधान.सन्ना वार्षिकी देया
lines_iast: prakṣepa.vṛddhir udayād ardhaṃ samnidhāna.sannā vārṣikī deyā

words.gloss: one who has entered an obstruction

hindi: लम्बे समय तक प्रवास में रहने वाला अथवा स्तम्भ में प्रविष्ट, मूल्य का दुगुना दे।
english: One long absent, or one who has entered an obstruction, should give twice the value.
notes: stambha = obstruction (glossary 8.4); 'pillar' or 'stupor' are other senses of the word, the line gives no context. mūlya literally 'value' (possibly 'principal'). Low-medium.
lines_deva: चिर.प्रवासः स्तम्भ.प्रविष्टो वा मूल्य.द्वि.गुणं दद्यात्
lines_iast: cira.pravāsaḥ stambha.praviṣṭo vā mūlya.dvi.guṇaṃ dadyāt

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √sādh
m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √vṛdh
m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √śru

hindi: ब्याज निश्चित किए बिना साधने वाले अथवा बढ़ाने वाले का, या मूल्य पर ब्याज चढ़ाकर सुनवाने वाले का, बन्ध का चौगुना दण्ड।
english: For one who, without having fixed interest, accomplishes [it] or makes [it] grow, or who, having imposed interest on the value, has [it] announced, the penalty is four times the bandha.
notes: akṛtvā is read 'a-kṛtvā' (without having made/fixed). sādhayataḥ literally 'accomplishing' (probably recovering the debt; sense not stated). bandha is an obscure term (literally 'binding'; here a fine unit) and is kept untranslated.
lines_deva: अकृत्वा वृद्धिं साधयतो वर्धयतो वा, मूल्यं वा वृद्धिम् आरोप्य श्रावयतो बन्ध.चतुर्.गुणो दण्डः
lines_iast: akṛtvā vṛddhiṃ sādhayato vardhayato vā, mūlyaṃ vā vṛddhim āropya śrāvayato bandha.catur.guṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: तुच्छ घोषणा में अभूत का चौगुना।
english: In [a case of] empty announcement, four times the non-existent.
notes: Elliptical. abhūta ('not existing') is left as 'the non-existent'; what is multiplied (amount, penalty) is not stated. Low confidence.
lines_deva: तुच्छ.श्रावणायाम् अभूत.चतुर्.गुणः
lines_iast: tuccha.śrāvaṇāyām abhūta.catur.guṇaḥ

hindi: उसका तीसरा भाग लेने वाला दे, शेष देने वाला।
english: Of that, the taker should give a third part, the remainder the giver [should give].
notes: ādātṛ/pradātṛ literally 'taker' / 'giver' (borrower and lender are the likely senses, not stated). 'dadyāt' carries over to pradātā.
lines_deva: तस्य त्रि.भागम् आदाता दद्यात्, शेषं प्रदाता
lines_iast: tasya tri.bhāgam ādātā dadyāt, śeṣaṃ pradātā

words.gloss: hindered by a long session, illness, a guru's household

hindi: लम्बे सत्र, रोग, गुरु-कुल से रुके हुए, बालक अथवा सारहीन के विषय में ऋण न बढ़े।
english: [In the case of] one hindered by a long sacrificial session, illness or a guru's household, a minor, or one without substance, the debt should not grow.
notes: Accusatives 'uparuddham, bālam, asāram' stand loosely before the sentence; rendered 'in the case of' (supplied). The long compound may be read as dvandva of dīrgha-sattra, vyādhi, guru-kula, each separately hindering; guru-kula may also be 'the family of elders' (guru plural = elders, glossary 4.10). asāra literally 'without substance/essence'. The token 'na-ṛṇam' is a '-' join of two words.
lines_deva: दीर्घ.सत्त्र.व्याधि.गुरु.कुल.उपरुद्धं बालम् असारं वा न-ऋणम् अनुवर्धेत
lines_iast: dīrgha.sattra.vyādhi.guru.kula.uparuddhaṃ bālam asāraṃ vā na-ṛṇam anuvardheta

words.gram: n. acc. sg. pres. part. pass. √muc
m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-prati-√grah

hindi: मुक्त किए जाते हुए ऋण को वापस न लेने वाले का बारह पण का दण्ड।
english: For one who does not take back a debt that is being released, the penalty is twelve paṇas.
notes: mucyamāna literally 'being released/freed' (probably offered in repayment; not stated).
lines_deva: मुच्यमानम् ऋणम् अप्रतिगृह्णतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: mucyamānam ṛṇam apratigṛhṇato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: by the pretext of a reason

hindi: कारण के बहाने से, जिसका ब्याज रुक गया है, दूसरी जगह रहे।
english: On the pretext of a reason, [it], its interest ceased, should stay elsewhere.
notes: Subject of tiṣṭhet and the referent of nivṛtta-vṛddhikam are not stated; '[it]' (the debt) is a guess. Person or debt both possible; alternative: 'he should remain elsewhere'. Low confidence.
lines_deva: कारण.अपदेशेन निवृत्त.वृद्धिकम् अन्यत्र तिष्ठेत्
lines_iast: kāraṇa.apadeśena nivṛtta.vṛddhikam anyatra tiṣṭhet

words.gloss: minors, aged, sick, afflicted (in calamity), absent, leaving the region, upheaval of the kingdom

hindi: दस वर्ष उपेक्षित ऋण वापस लेने योग्य नहीं, बालकों, वृद्धों, रोगियों, व्यसन वाले, प्रवासियों, देश-त्याग और राज्य-विभ्रम को छोड़कर।
english: A debt neglected for ten years is not to be taken back, except in [the cases of] minors, the aged, the sick, the afflicted, the absent, leaving the region and upheaval of the kingdom.
notes: The last compound is a dvandva with seven items: bāla, vṛddha, vyādhita, vyasani, proṣita, deśa-tyāga, rājya-vibhrama (the last two may also be one phrase). vyasani here read as 'one afflicted by calamity'; 'one given to vice' is the alternative (glossary 4.6). rājya-vibhrama literally 'confusion/disorder of the kingdom'. Ablative with anyatra rendered 'in the cases of'.
lines_deva: दश.वर्ष.उपेक्षितम् ऋणम् अप्रतिग्राह्यम्, अन्यत्र बाल.वृद्ध.व्याधित.व्यसनि.प्रोषित.देश.त्याग.राज्य.विभ्रमेभ्यः
lines_iast: daśa.varṣa.upekṣitam ṛṇam apratigrāhyam, anyatra bāla.vṛddha.vyādhita.vyasani.proṣita.deśa.tyāga.rājya.vibhramebhyaḥ

hindi: मृतक के पुत्र कुसीद दें, अथवा उत्तराधिकारी, रिक्थ लेने वाले, साथ ग्रहण करने वाले, अथवा प्रतिभू।
english: The sons of the deceased should pay the kusīda (loan at interest), or the heirs, the takers of the inheritance, the co-takers, or the sureties.
notes: kusīda = loan at interest (money-lending); kept as the word with a gloss. saha-grāhin literally 'taking together' (joint takers of the loan is the likely sense). The printed 'dāyādā vā' is regular sandhi (dāyādāḥ vā).
lines_deva: प्रेतस्य पुत्राः कुसीदं दद्युः, दायादा वा रिक्थ.हराः, सह.ग्राहिणः, प्रतिभुवो वा
lines_iast: pretasya putrāḥ kusīdaṃ dadyuḥ, dāyādā vā riktha.harāḥ, saha.grāhiṇaḥ, pratibhuvo vā

hindi: अन्य ज़मानत नहीं।
english: Not [any] other suretyship.
notes: Very brief; the sense is unclear (perhaps 'no other suretyship [is to be discharged by the sons]', or 'suretyship is not otherwise'). Rendered literally; low confidence.
lines_deva: न प्रातिभाव्यम् अन्यत्
lines_iast: na prātibhāvyam anyat

hindi: बालक की ज़मानत सारहीन है।
english: Suretyship of a minor [is] without substance.
notes: asāra literally 'without substance/essence'. '[is]' is a bare copula.
lines_deva: असारं बाल.प्रातिभाव्यम्
lines_iast: asāraṃ bāla.prātibhāvyam

words.gloss: with place and time not specified

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. ātm. √hṛ

hindi: किन्तु जिसमें स्थान और समय निर्दिष्ट नहीं है, उसे पुत्र, पौत्र अथवा उत्तराधिकारी रिक्थ ग्रहण करते हुए दें।
english: But [that] of which place and time are not specified, sons, grandsons or heirs, taking the inheritance, should give.
notes: The object (probably the suretyship of the preceding lines) is not stated; the adjective asaṅkhyāta-deśa-kālam stands alone. Rendered with '[that]'.
lines_deva: असङ्ख्यात.देश.कालं तु पुत्राः पौत्रा दायादा वा रिक्थं हरमाणा दद्युः
lines_iast: asaṅkhyāta.deśa.kālaṃ tu putrāḥ pautrā dāyādā vā rikthaṃ haramāṇā dadyuḥ

words.gloss: suretyship for life, marriage and land
with place and time not specified

hindi: किन्तु जीवन, विवाह और भूमि की ज़मानत, जिसमें स्थान और समय निर्दिष्ट नहीं है, उसे पुत्र अथवा पौत्र वहन करें।
english: But suretyship for life, marriage and land, with place and time not specified, sons or grandsons should bear.
notes: jīvita-prātibhāvya literally 'suretyship of life' (a guarantee about a person's being alive) is not further explained in the text. Whether the suretyship is in each case the three kinds or 'life' alone is not settled by the compound.
lines_deva: जीवित.विवाह.भूमि.प्रातिभाव्यम् असङ्ख्यात.देश.कालं तु पुत्राः पौत्रा वा वहेयुः
lines_iast: jīvita.vivāha.bhūmi.prātibhāvyam asaṅkhyāta.deśa.kālaṃ tu putrāḥ pautrā vā vaheyuḥ

words.gram: m. abl. sg. pres. part. ātm. prati-√sthā

hindi: किन्तु अनेक ऋणों के एकत्र होने पर दो एक को एक साथ न पुकारें, प्रस्थान करते हुए को छोड़कर।
english: But when various debts come together, two [persons] should not at once claim against one, except [in the case of] one who is setting out.
notes: abhi-√vad literally 'address'; 'claim against / lay a claim' is the sense in this legal context (medium). The persons (creditors) and the one claimed against (debtor) are not named; '[persons]' is supplied. Hindi keeps the literal 'पुकारें' (address). 'nānā-ṛṇa.samavāye' is nānā + ṛṇa-samavāye (a '-' join of two words).
lines_deva: नाना-ऋण.समवाये तु न-एकं द्वौ युगपद् अभिवदेयाताम्, अन्यत्र प्रतिष्ठमानात्
lines_iast: nānā-ṛṇa.samavāye tu na-ekaṃ dvau yugapad abhivadeyātām, anyatra pratiṣṭhamānāt

words.gloss: property of the king and the śrotriya
he should cause to be handed over

hindi: वहाँ भी लिए जाने के क्रम से, अथवा राजा और श्रोत्रिय के द्रव्य को, पहले सौंपवाए।
english: Even there, in the order of taking, or the property of the king and the śrotriya, [he] should first cause to be handed over.
notes: The elliptical construction: 'in the order of taking' qualifies the payment; the object is the creditors' claims or the property. rāja-śrotriya may be read 'of the king and of a śrotriya' (as rendered) or 'of a royal śrotriya'. Subject of pratipādayet unstated. Low-medium.
lines_deva: तत्र-अपि गृहीत.आनुपूर्व्या राज.श्रोत्रिय.द्रव्यं वा पूर्वं प्रतिपादयेत्
lines_iast: tatra-api gṛhīta.ānupūrvyā rāja.śrotriya.dravyaṃ vā pūrvaṃ pratipādayet

hindi: पति-पत्नी, पिता-पुत्र और अविभक्त भाइयों के परस्पर किया हुआ ऋण साधने योग्य नहीं।
english: A debt made mutually between husband and wife, between father and son, and between undivided brothers is not to be accomplished.

text_flags.why: Doubled compound dot, a stray character in the typed text; the compound is paraspara-kṛtam 'done mutually'.

notes: 'pitā.putrayoḥ' keeps the ā-stem (like mātā-pitarau); normal pitṛ-putrayoḥ would also be read the same. asādhya literally 'not to be accomplished' (probably 'not enforceable').
lines_deva: दम्पत्योः पिता.पुत्रयोः भ्रातॄणां च-अविभक्तानां परस्पर..कृतम् ऋणम् असाध्यम्
lines_iast: dampatyoḥ pitā.putrayoḥ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca-avibhaktānāṃ paraspara..kṛtam ṛṇam asādhyam

hindi: काम के समय किसान और राजपुरुष पकड़े जाने योग्य नहीं।
english: Farmers and king's men are not to be seized during the times of work.
notes: karma-kāla literally 'times of work' (work not specified).
lines_deva: अग्राह्याः कर्म.कालेषु कर्षका राज.पुरुषाश् च
lines_iast: agrāhyāḥ karma.kāleṣu karṣakā rāja.puruṣāś ca

hindi: और स्त्री जिसने वचन नहीं दिया, पति के किए हुए ऋण में, गोपालकों और अर्ध-सीतिकों को छोड़कर।
english: And a woman who has not promised [is not to be seized] for a debt made by the husband, except [in the case of] cowherds and ardha-sītikas.
notes: Predicate not stated; '[is not to be seized]' carries 'agrāhyāḥ' over from the previous unit (the unit is verbless). apratiśrāviṇī literally 'not promising' (prati-√śru). ardha-sītika is obscure (literally 'having half the sītā, furrow-produce') and is kept untranslated. Medium-low.
lines_deva: स्त्री च-अप्रतिश्राविणी पति.कृतम् ऋणम्, अन्यत्र गो.पालक.अर्ध.सीतिकेभ्यः
lines_iast: strī ca-apratiśrāviṇī pati.kṛtam ṛṇam, anyatra go.pālaka.ardha.sītikebhyaḥ

hindi: किन्तु पत्नी के किए हुए ऋण में पति पकड़ा जाए, प्रबन्ध किए बिना चले जाने पर।
english: But the husband is to be seized for a debt made by the wife, [if] he has gone away without making provision.

text_flags.why: closing iti with no opening quotation mark in the unit; rendered as a condition (possible)

notes: The closing iti marks the reason/condition clause ('that he has gone away ...') and is not rendered separately (glossary: no 'thus'). '[if]' is supplied. aprati-vidhāya literally 'without having provided'.
lines_deva: पतिस् तु ग्राह्यः स्त्री.कृतम् ऋणम्, अप्रति.विधाय प्रोषित इति
lines_iast: patis tu grāhyaḥ strī.kṛtam ṛṇam, aprati.vidhāya proṣita iti

hindi: स्वीकृति में सर्वोच्च।
english: In admission, the highest.
notes: Very elliptical. sampratipatti literally 'agreement, acceptance, admission'. What is 'the highest' (a witness class, a penalty or a person) is not stated; nothing is supplied (glossary 4.11 for bare uttama). Low confidence.
lines_deva: सम्प्रतिपत्ताव् उत्तमः
lines_iast: sampratipattāv uttamaḥ

words.gloss: avara-ardhya (obscure, kept; literally 'of the lower half')

hindi: किन्तु अस्वीकृति में साक्षी प्रमाण हैं: विश्वासपात्र, शुद्ध अथवा अनुमत, तीन अवर-अर्ध्य।
english: But in non-admission, the witnesses [are] the proof: trustworthy, pure or approved, three avara-ardhya.

text_flags.why: Possible typo: 'asma-' is not a word; the sense (non-admission, contrasting with sampratipattau in the previous unit) calls for a-sampratipattau, with m misplaced.

notes: avara-ardhya is obscure: literally 'belonging to the lower half'; 'at least three' (avara 'lowest') is a possible sense but is not forced into the translation. prātyayika literally 'of trust' (pratyaya). '[are]' is a bare copula. The printed 'śucayo' and 'anumatā' (for anumatāḥ before vā) are regular sandhi. Review: avara-ardhya kept untranslated in English and Hindi (sense, e.g. 'at least', not settled).
lines_deva: अस्मप्रतिपत्तौ तु साक्षिणः प्रमाणं प्रात्ययिकाः शुचयो ऽनुमता वा त्रयो ऽवर.अर्ध्याः
lines_iast: asmapratipattau tu sākṣiṇaḥ pramāṇaṃ prātyayikāḥ śucayo 'numatā vā trayo 'vara.ardhyāḥ

hindi: अथवा पक्ष की अनुमति होने पर दो; ऋण के विषय में किन्तु एक कदापि नहीं।
english: Or two, when approved by a party; with regard to a debt, but never one.
notes: Elliptical; the persons meant (witnesses) are not named in this unit. pakṣa literally 'side, party'. 'na tu eva' rendered 'but never' (eva 'indeed').
lines_deva: पक्ष.अनुमतौ वा द्वौ, ऋणं प्रति न त्व् एव-एकः
lines_iast: pakṣa.anumatau vā dvau, ṛṇaṃ prati na tv eva-ekaḥ

words.gloss: wife's brother, associate, anvarthin, creditor, debtor, enemy, nyaṅga, those who have borne a penalty

hindi: निषिद्ध: पत्नी के भाई, सहायक, अन्वर्थी, धनिक, ऋणी, शत्रु, न्यङ्ग, दण्ड धारण किए हुए; और पूर्व वाले व्यवहार के अयोग्य हैं।
english: Prohibited [as witnesses]: the wife's brother, the associate, the anvarthin, the creditor, the debtor, the enemy, the nyaṅga, and those who have borne a penalty; and the former are not to be dealt with.
notes: '[as witnesses]' is supplied from context (the unit follows the witness rules); not in the Sanskrit. anvarthin and nyaṅga are obscure and kept untranslated (anvarthin literally 'one following an object/interest'). dhṛta-daṇḍa literally 'having held/borne a penalty'. avyavahārya literally 'not to be dealt with' (vyavahāra 'dealings'); 'pūrve' (the former) is taken as the earlier items of the list. Low-medium.
lines_deva: प्रतिषिद्धाः स्याल.सहाय.अन्वर्थि.धनिक.धारणिक.वैरि.न्यङ्ग.धृत.दण्डाः, पूर्वे च-अव्यवहार्याः
lines_iast: pratiṣiddhāḥ syāla.sahāya.anvarthi.dhanika.dhāraṇika.vairi.nyaṅga.dhṛta.daṇḍāḥ, pūrve ca-avyavahāryāḥ

words.gloss: king, śrotriya, village hireling, one with kuṣṭha, the wounded
fallen ones, caṇḍālas, those of despicable work
blind, deaf, mute, those who say 'I'

hindi: राजा, श्रोत्रिय, ग्राम का भृतक, कुष्ठ वाले, घाव वाले; पतित, चाण्डाल, निन्दित कर्म वाले; अन्धे, बहरे, गूँगे, 'मैं' कहने वाले, स्त्रियाँ और राजपुरुष, अपने वर्गों को छोड़कर।
english: [Prohibited are] the king, the śrotriya, the village hireling, those with kuṣṭha, the wounded; the fallen, caṇḍālas, those of despicable work; the blind, the deaf, the mute, those who say 'I'; women and king's men, except from their own groups.
notes: Continues the list of 'pratiṣiddhāḥ' of the previous unit; '[Prohibited are]' is supplied (no GROUPING error, the two units are one sentence). The compounds are dvandvas; 'rāja' (king) and 'rāja-puruṣa' (king's man) both occur. kuṣṭhin literally 'having kuṣṭha' (a skin affliction, no diagnosis made). aham-vādin literally 'one who says aham (I)'; sense (boaster, self-asserter?) not stated. 'sva-vargebhyaḥ' (from their own groups) is an exception clause; meaning not stated. Medium-low.
lines_deva: राज.श्रोत्रिय.ग्राम.भृतक.कुष्ठि.व्रणिनः पतित.चण्डाल.कुत्सित.कर्माणो ऽन्ध.बधिर.मूक.अहं.वादिनः स्त्री.राज.पुरुषाश् च, अन्यत्र स्व.वर्गेभ्यः
lines_iast: rāja.śrotriya.grāma.bhṛtaka.kuṣṭhi.vraṇinaḥ patita.caṇḍāla.kutsita.karmāṇo 'ndha.badhira.mūka.ahaṃ.vādinaḥ strī.rāja.puruṣāś ca, anyatra sva.vargebhyaḥ

hindi: किन्तु पारुष्य, चोरी और संग्रहण में शत्रु, पत्नी के भाई और सहायक को छोड़कर।
english: But in cases of harshness, theft and seizure, [persons] excluding the enemy, the wife's brother and the associate.
notes: Elliptical: 'varjāḥ' (excluding) qualifies an unstated group, probably the persons of the preceding prohibition. pāruṣya literally 'harshness' (verbal or physical injury in Book 3; glossary 3.18-19). saṅgrahaṇa literally 'taking together, seizing'. Low-medium.
lines_deva: पारुष्य.स्तेय.सङ्ग्रहणेषु तु वैरि.स्याल.सहाय.वर्जाः
lines_iast: pāruṣya.steya.saṅgrahaṇeṣu tu vairi.syāla.sahāya.varjāḥ

hindi: गुप्त व्यवहारों में एक स्त्री, पुरुष, पास से सुनने वाला अथवा पास से देखने वाला साक्षी हो, राजा और तपस्वी को छोड़कर।
english: In secret dealings, one woman, a man, an overhearer or an onlooker may be a witness, excluding the king and the ascetic.
notes: 'ekā strī puruṣa upaśrotā upadraṣṭā vā': the grouping of 'ekā' (feminine, agreeing with strī) and the 'vā' (only after upadraṣṭā) is ambiguous; 'one woman, a man' may also be 'a single woman or man' as an overhearer or onlooker. upaśrotṛ literally 'one listening near', upadraṣṭṛ 'one seeing near'. rāja-tāpasa-varjam as an adverbial 'excluding'.
lines_deva: रहस्य.व्यवहारेष्व् एका स्त्री पुरुष उपश्रोता उपद्रष्टा वा साक्षी स्याद् राज.तापस.वर्जम्
lines_iast: rahasya.vyavahāreṣv ekā strī puruṣa upaśrotā upadraṣṭā vā sākṣī syād rāja.tāpasa.varjam

words.gloss: they should make (sākṣyam kuryuḥ = give testimony)

hindi: स्वामी सेवकों के, ऋत्विज् और आचार्य शिष्यों के, और माता-पिता पुत्रों के, बिना रोक-टोक के साक्ष्य दें, अथवा इनमें से दूसरे।
english: Masters of servants, officiating priests and teachers of pupils, and mother and father of sons should give testimony without restraint, or others of them.

text_flags.why: s for ṣ: the genitive plural of tad is teṣām.

notes: svāmin here 'master' (not the prakṛti 'king'). anigraha literally 'non-restraint / no checking'; its exact sense (without being penalised? without compulsion?) is not stated. 'teṣām itare vā' = 'or others of them'. 'ṛtvig' is the sandhi form of ṛtvij before ā; w uses the stem.
lines_deva: स्वामिनो भृत्यानाम् ऋत्विग्.आचार्याः शिष्याणां माता.पितरौ पुत्राणां च-अनिग्रहेण साक्ष्यं कुर्युः, तेसाम् इतरे वा
lines_iast: svāmino bhṛtyānām ṛtvig.ācāryāḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ mātā.pitarau putrāṇāṃ ca-anigraheṇa sākṣyaṃ kuryuḥ, tesām itare vā

hindi: और इनके परस्पर अभियोग में, सर्वोच्च परा-उक्त दश-बन्ध दें, निम्नतम पञ्च-बन्ध। यह साक्षी-अधिकार है।
english: And in mutual accusation among these, the highest parā-uktas should give a daśa-bandha, the lowest a pañca-bandha. Such is the section on witnesses.
notes: The line contains the verse mark and number '| 33 |' and the closing label 'iti sākṣi-adhikāraḥ' ('iti' not rendered, glossary). 'sākṣy.adhikāraḥ' is printed with sandhi y; w uses sākṣi-adhikāraḥ. The sense of 'uttamāḥ parā.uktā' is doubtful (the highest ones, being spoken of by the other?). bandha is untranslated (obscure), as in unit 7. Low-medium. Review: parā.uktā is the edition's regular spelling of parā-ukta (as in 3.1), so the drafter's text_flag is withdrawn (a person should delete it); parā-ukta, daśa-bandha and pañca-bandha are kept untranslated (3.1, 3.13). The construction 'uttamāḥ parā-uktāḥ' (the highest parā-uktas) is still doubtful.
lines_deva: परस्पर.अभियोगे च-एषाम् उत्तमाः परा.उक्ता दश.बन्धं दद्युः, अवराः पञ्च.बन्धम् । ३३ । इति साक्ष्य्.अधिकारः
lines_iast: paraspara.abhiyoge ca-eṣām uttamāḥ parā.uktā daśa.bandhaṃ dadyuḥ, avarāḥ pañca.bandham | 33 | iti sākṣy.adhikāraḥ

words.gloss: in the presence of a brāhmaṇa, water-pot and fire

hindi: ब्राह्मण, जल-कुम्भ और अग्नि के समीप साक्षियों को ग्रहण करे।
english: In the presence of a brāhmaṇa, a water-pot and fire, he should take up the witnesses.
notes: uda = water (older form); uda-kumbha 'water-pot'. parigṛhṇīyāt literally 'should take up / accept'; the sense (examine, receive their statements) is not stated.
lines_deva: ब्राह्मण.उद.कुम्भ.अग्नि.सकाशे साक्षिणः परिगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: brāhmaṇa.uda.kumbha.agni.sakāśe sākṣiṇaḥ parigṛhṇīyāt

hindi: वहाँ ब्राह्मण से कहे: “सत्य बोलो।”
english: There he should say to the brāhmaṇa: “Speak the truth.”
notes: The closing iti of the quotation is carried by the quotation marks only (glossary 13.1). The printed straight quotes are balanced.
lines_deva: तत्र ब्राह्मणं ब्रूयात् "सत्यं ब्रूहि" इति
lines_iast: tatra brāhmaṇaṃ brūyāt "satyaṃ brūhi" iti

hindi: राजन्य अथवा वैश्य से: “तुम्हारा इष्टापूर्त का फल न हो; हाथ में कपाल लिए, भिक्षा चाहते हुए तुम शत्रु के कुल में जाओगे।”
english: [He should say] to a rājanya or a vaiśya: “[Let there be] no fruit of your iṣṭā-pūrta; with a skull in hand, seeking alms, you would go to the family of an enemy.”
notes: The verb 'brūyāt' is carried over from the previous unit ('[He should say]'). 'mā tava iṣṭā-pūrta-phalam' is elliptical (the optative 'syāt' or similar is not printed); read as a wish that the fruit be lost; the conditional 'if you lie' is not in the Sanskrit. iṣṭā-pūrta literally 'what is offered and what is filled/bestowed' (sacrifice and pious works). rājanya, vaiśya kept as terms. The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks. Medium-low.
lines_deva: राजन्यं वैश्यं वा "मा तव-इष्टा.पूर्त.फलम्, कपाल.हस्तः शत्रु.कुलं भिक्षा.अर्थी गच्छेः" इति
lines_iast: rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā "mā tava-iṣṭā.pūrta.phalam, kapāla.hastaḥ śatru.kulaṃ bhikṣā.arthī gaccheḥ" iti

words.gloss: in the interval between birth and death

hindi: शूद्र से: “जन्म और मरण के बीच जो तुम्हारे पुण्य का फल है, वह राजा के पास जाए, और राजा का किल्बिष तुम्हारे पास, यदि अन्यथा कहो; और दण्ड साथ बँधा है; बाद में भी देखे-सुने के अनुसार जाना जाए; एक मत होकर सत्य अर्पित करो।”
english: [He should say] to a śūdra: “Whatever fruit of merit is yours between birth and death, that would go to the king, and the king's sin [would go] to you, in case of speaking otherwise; and a penalty is attached; even afterwards it would be known as seen and heard. Of one counsel, bring forth the truth.”
notes: 'brūyāt' is carried over from the two previous units. 'gacchet' carries to the second clause ('[would go] to you'). 'yathā-dṛṣṭa-śrutam' = 'as seen and heard'; 'paścād api jñāyeta' is read as 'even afterwards it would be known' (alternative: 'it should be ascertained'). eka-mantra literally 'having one counsel' (unanimous). Hindi 'यदि अन्यथा कहो' renders the locative 'anyathā-vāde'. The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks. Medium-low.
lines_deva: शूद्रं "जन्म.मरण.अन्तरे यद् वः पुण्य.फलं तद् राजानं गच्छेद्, राज्ञश् च किल्बिषं युष्मान् अन्यथा.वादे, दण्डश् च-अनुबद्धः, पश्चाद् अपि ज्ञायेत यथा.दृष्ट.श्रुतम्, एक.मन्त्राः सत्यम् उपहरत" इति
lines_iast: śūdraṃ "janma.maraṇa.antare yad vaḥ puṇya.phalaṃ tad rājānaṃ gacched, rājñaś ca kilbiṣaṃ yuṣmān anyathā.vāde, daṇḍaś ca-anubaddhaḥ, paścād api jñāyeta yathā.dṛṣṭa.śrutam, eka.mantrāḥ satyam upaharata" iti

words.gram: m. gen. pl. pres. part. an-upa-√hṛ

hindi: जो अर्पित नहीं करते उनका सात रात के बाद बारह पण का दण्ड; तीन पक्ष के बाद वे अभियोग दें।
english: For those who do not bring forth [it], after seven nights the penalty is twelve paṇas; after three fortnights they should give the claim.
notes: The object of anupaharatām is not stated (presumably the truth/testimony of the previous unit); '[it]' is supplied. 'abhiyogam dadyuḥ' literally 'should give the accusation/claim'; the sense (pay the amount claimed?) is not stated. pakṣa taken as 'fortnight'. Low.
lines_deva: अनुपहरतां सप्त.रात्राद् ऊर्ध्वं द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, त्रि.पक्षाद् ऊर्ध्वम् अभियोगं दद्युः
lines_iast: anupaharatāṃ sapta.rātrād ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, tri.pakṣād ūrdhvam abhiyogaṃ dadyuḥ

hindi: साक्षियों में भेद होने पर जहाँ बहुत से शुद्ध अथवा अनुमत हों, वहाँ से निर्णय करें, अथवा मध्य को ग्रहण करें।
english: In a split among witnesses, from where [there are] many pure or approved ones, from there they should settle; or they should take the middle.
notes: ni-√yam literally 'restrain, control'; rendered 'settle' (decide) in this context, medium-low. The object is unstated. 'madhyam' (the middle) is not further explained (a middle course or the middle of the statements). The printed 'śucayo' and 'anumatā' are regular sandhi.
lines_deva: साक्षि.भेदे यतो बहवः शुचयो ऽनुमता वा ततो नियच्छेयुः, मध्यं वा गृह्णीयुः
lines_iast: sākṣi.bhede yato bahavaḥ śucayo 'numatā vā tato niyaccheyuḥ, madhyaṃ vā gṛhṇīyuḥ

hindi: अथवा उस द्रव्य को राजा ले ले।
english: Or the king should take that property.
notes: 'tat dravyam' refers to the disputed property, not stated here.
lines_deva: तद् वा द्रव्यं राजा हरेत्
lines_iast: tad vā dravyaṃ rājā haret

hindi: यदि साक्षी अभियोग से कम कहें, तो अधिक का अभियोग करने वाला बन्ध दे।
english: If the witnesses should state less than the claim, the claimant of the excess should give a bandha.
notes: atiriktasya-abhiyoktā ('the claimant of the excess') is a '-' join in the print and is two words. bandha untranslated (obscure), as in units 7 and 33.
lines_deva: साक्षिणश् चेद् अभियोगाद् ऊनं ब्रूयुर् अतिरिक्तस्य-अभियोक्ता बन्धं दद्यात्
lines_iast: sākṣiṇaś ced abhiyogād ūnaṃ brūyur atiriktasya-abhiyoktā bandhaṃ dadyāt

hindi: अथवा अधिक कहें, उस अधिक को राजा ले ले।
english: Or [if] they should state more, the king should take that excess.
notes: 'atiriktam' and 'tad-atiriktam': 'more' and 'that excess', literally.
lines_deva: अतिरिक्तं वा ब्रूयुस् तद्.अतिरिक्तं राजा हरेत्
lines_iast: atiriktaṃ vā brūyus tad.atiriktaṃ rājā haret

hindi: अभियोक्ता की मूर्खता से, अथवा बुरी तरह सुने हुए, बुरी तरह लिखे हुए, अथवा मृतक के अभिनिवेश को विचारकर, साक्षियों का विश्वास ही हो।
english: Having considered the claimant's foolishness, or what is ill-heard, ill-written, or the deceased's persistence, reliance on the witnesses alone should be [the rule].

text_flags.why: h typed for visarga: the compound dus-śruta gives duḥśrutam.

notes: Elliptical; the construction is uncertain: 'bāliśyāt abhiyoktuḥ' may be read 'from the claimant's foolishness' (cause) rather than an object of samīkṣya. preta-abhiniveśa is obscure (literally 'persistence/insistence of the deceased'; preta = the deceased, glossary 5.3). '[the rule]' is supplied. Low confidence.
lines_deva: बालिश्याद् अभियोक्तुर् वा दुह्श्रुतं दुर्लिखितं प्रेत.अभिनिवेशं वा समीक्ष्य साक्षि.प्रत्ययम् एव स्यात्
lines_iast: bāliśyād abhiyoktur vā duhśrutaṃ durlikhitaṃ preta.abhiniveśaṃ vā samīkṣya sākṣi.pratyayam eva syāt

hindi: “साक्षियों की मूर्खता में ही, अलग-अलग पूछताछ होने पर, देश, काल और कार्य के प्रथम, मध्यम और उत्तम दण्ड हैं,” ऐसा औशनस कहते हैं।
english: “Only in the foolishness of witnesses, in separate questioning, the penalties of place, time and matter are the first, middle and highest,” say the Aushanasas.

text_flags.why: ṣ typed for ś: the word is bāliśya (cf. bāliśyāt in the previous unit).

notes: Quoted view of a school (glossary 3.6: Aushanasa). anuyoga here 'questioning' (glossary 4.7/4.8). The meaning of 'deśa-kāla-kāryāṇām ... daṇḍāḥ' (penalties graded by place, time, matter?) is doubtful. kārya literally 'what is to be done / matter'. Low.
lines_deva: "साक्षि.बालिष्येष्व् एव पृथग्.अनुयोगे देश.काल.कार्याणां पूर्व.मध्यम.उत्तमा दण्डाः" इत्य् औशनसाः
lines_iast: "sākṣi.bāliṣyeṣv eva pṛthag.anuyoge deśa.kāla.kāryāṇāṃ pūrva.madhyama.uttamā daṇḍāḥ" ity auśanasāḥ

hindi: “झूठे साक्षी जिस अर्थ को अभूत करें अथवा भूत को नष्ट करें, उसका दसगुना दण्ड दें,” ऐसा मानव कहते हैं।
english: “False witnesses, [regarding] the matter which they should make non-existent, or [the matter] existent they should destroy, should give that, a tenfold penalty,” say the Manavas.
notes: Quoted view of the Manavas (glossary 15.1). artha 'matter' (possibly 'wealth/property'); abhūtam/bhūtam 'non-existent'/'existent' are left literal. 'tat daśa-guṇam daṇḍam' = 'that, a tenfold penalty'. The Manavas are named as plural group (glossary 15.1).
lines_deva: "कूट.साक्षिणो यम् अर्थम् अभूतं कुर्युर् भूतं वा नाशयेयुस् तद् दश.गुणं दण्डं दद्युः" इति मानवाः
lines_iast: "kūṭa.sākṣiṇo yam artham abhūtaṃ kuryur bhūtaṃ vā nāśayeyus tad daśa.guṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ" iti mānavāḥ

words.gram: m. gen. pl. pres. part. caus. vi-sam-√vad

hindi: “अथवा मूर्खता से विसंवाद कराने वालों का विविध प्रकार का वध,” ऐसा बार्हस्पत्य कहते हैं।
english: “Or from foolishness, for those who cause disagreement, a varied killing,” say the Barhaspatyas.
notes: Quoted view of the Barhaspatyas (glossary 15.1). citra ghāta = varied killing (glossary 4.9/4.11). visaṃvādayatām literally 'of those causing contradiction/disagreement'; sense of 'of those' (penalty for those) is by the genitive.
lines_deva: "बालिश्याद् वा विसंवादयतां चित्रो घातः" इति बार्हस्पत्याः
lines_iast: "bāliśyād vā visaṃvādayatāṃ citro ghātaḥ" iti bārhaspatyāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
notes: Formula 'na iti X' (glossary 12.1, 'Teachers quoted'). The token 'na-iti' is a '-' join of two words (na, iti).
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-iti kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि साक्षियों द्वारा निश्चित रूप से सुना जाना चाहिए।
english: For it must certainly be heard by the witnesses.
notes: Subject of śrotavyam unstated ('it'). dhruvam literally 'firmly, fixedly'. 'hi' rendered 'for'; Hindi avoids ही for hi.
lines_deva: ध्रुवं हि साक्षिभिः श्रोतव्यम्
lines_iast: dhruvaṃ hi sākṣibhiḥ śrotavyam

words.gram: m. gen. pl. pres. part. a-√śru
m. gen. pl. pres. part. ātm. a-√brū

hindi: न सुनने वालों का चौबीस पण का दण्ड, उससे आधा न बोलने वालों का।
english: For those who do not hear, the penalty is twenty-four paṇas; half of that for those who do not speak.
notes: '[is]' not needed in the translation; 'tato ardham' = 'half of that'.
lines_deva: अशृण्वतां चतुर्.विंशति.पणो दण्डः, ततो ऽर्धम् अब्रुवाणानाम्
lines_iast: aśṛṇvatāṃ catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, tato 'rdham abruvāṇānām

words.gloss: those standing not far in place and time
by the statement of the master

hindi: जो देश और काल में दूर नहीं हैं, उन साक्षियों को प्रस्तुत करे; दूर स्थित अथवा आगे न जाने वालों को स्वामी के वाक्य से साधे।
english: He should produce witnesses not far away in place and time; those who are far away or not going forth, he should accomplish by the statement of the master.
notes: pratipādayet (caus. prati-√pad) 'cause to be delivered', rendered 'produce' here and 'hand over' in unit 20. aprasāra literally 'not spreading/going forth' (sense, e.g. unable to travel, not stated; 10.2 prasāra is unrelated). sādhayet 'accomplish' (probably 'establish [the matter]'). svāmin here 'master' (of the matter; the king per prakṛti glossary is not clearly meant). 'deśa-kāla-avidūrasthān' may also be 'not far in place; time' split. Low-medium.
lines_deva: देश.काल.अविदूरस्थान् साक्षिणः प्रतिपादयेत्
दूरस्थान् अप्रसारान् वा स्वामि.वाक्येन साधयेत्
lines_iast: deśa.kāla.avidūrasthān sākṣiṇaḥ pratipādayet
dūrasthān aprasārān vā svāmi.vākyena sādhayet
